verdict.rationale: Lindy runs automated routines, so inspecting execution history and re-running failed runs is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack never documents execution logs, run history, or a way to re-run or resume a failed execution from its failing step. The only nearby item, the '/lindy usage' Slack diagnostics command, reports connection diagnostics rather than per-execution logs, so it is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can inspect past execution logs and re-run a failed execution, resuming from the failing step
